surat.headline: Surat textile cluster faces severe margin compression and labor unrest ahead of Diwali.
what_changed: Surat weavers initiated a two-day weekly holiday and plant shutdowns due to weak grey fabric demand and high input costs [161041af6dcb, 0c72a246c955].
Textile trade dropped by 50 percent following a doubling of coal prices impacting processing units [16a5b570eb9e].
The diamond industry bucked the trend by shortening its traditional Diwali vacation due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Weavers face strict yarn payment rules requiring settlement within 15 days ahead of Diwali [0c72a246c955, 57e5e152a5cb].
Intensified 'Gaon Chalo' protests and labor unrest regarding work hours, exploitation, and wage disputes hit textile and embroidery units [ce4764831b1f, 81627c3e849c, 73dfcce5d3f4, af6d72aecf71].
A major textile fraud amounting to Rs 15.57 crore was uncovered by Surat police [cf2229091691].
Physical disruptions occurred, including industrial fires at a yarn unit in Pipodara GIDC and a diamond risk incident [42bc4e18e52d, 8103ae8facb8].
improvement_signals: Surat's diamond sector shortened its Diwali vacation duration for the first time in four years due to positive demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
ICA-GemLab is establishing its first Indian laboratory in Surat, bolstering testing services [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Monitor cash flow and working capital cycles of weaving units adhering to strict 15-day yarn payment norms.
Track account-level overdue status for processing units impacted by doubled coal prices and plunging trade volumes.
Assess post-Diwali worker return rates to gauge the severity of the 'Gaon Chalo' labor migration impact.
